Name: Gabagool
Author: LinSterling
Description:
[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Description[/size][/color][/b]
Adds a new artisan item: gabagool. Put 4 pieces of pork into the dehydrator, wait for 2 days, and make Tony proud.

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
  1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
  2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
  3. source of pork, i.e. a meat mod
  🥩 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rose's Cruelty Free Meat[/url]
OR
  🥩 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] (if you don't want to chop your farm friends into meat ribbons - disable meat button and meat tool in AHM config and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39227]Appleseed's Lab-Grown Meat[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27938]Soy Bean Meats[/url])

Alternatively, you can install both of the meat mods and have yourself a giant meatfest.

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
  1. Download
  2. Unzip
  3. Put "Gabagool" into Stardew Valley\Mods
  4. Should work unless I borked something (in that case, let me know)
  5. Enjoy!
  6. Maybe endorse this mod if you liked it? :3

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Known (slight) Issues[/size][/color][/b]
If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rose's Cruelty Free Meat[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39239]Jerky Time[/url] (or both), the dehydrator has other meat related recipes: 5 pieces for dried meat / 3 pieces for jerky. Gabagool will still work but you need to put in exactly 4 pieces which might be tricky with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] - you can't just load up a chest with pork and let it cook. Gabagool requires care and patience.
You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28261]Machine Control Panel[/url] to turn off some machine rules.
